page.title: Templates
page.about: herdr-core's agent templates: a command and a role saved once, then started by name with a task (hc run <name> "task"). Each machine has its own.

no_folder: The folder appears with the first template.
empty_about: Make one for a role you hand out often: a reviewer, a test writer, a fixer.
trash_ask: Move {name} to the Trash? You can put it back from there.
others: Kept as they are: {keys} (fields this editor doesn't show).

hc.no_frontmatter: hc can't read it: the first line must be ---.
hc.never_closes: hc can't read it: the header never ends with ---.
hc.not_key_value: hc can't read it: a header line isn't key: value:
hc.no_command: hc can't run it: it has no command.
hc.paste_gap_number: hc can't read it: paste_gap_ms must be a whole number.

errors.changed: This template changed somewhere else since you opened it. Read it again, then edit.
errors.name_invalid: {name} isn't a name hc can run.
errors.old_kept: Saved {name}, but the old {old} couldn't go to the Trash: both files are there.

field.name: Name
field.name_hint: You start it with hc run <name>: the file name without .md.
field.description_placeholder: Read-only code review. Give it file paths.
field.command_hint: Starts the agent, through sh. Put the model and other options here.
field.ready: When to send the first message
field.body_hint: The agent's first message; the task you give follows after a blank line.

ready.status_about: herdr-core waits for the agent's first status report (up to 30 s).
ready.quiet_about: For a program that doesn't report status. Quiet isn't proof it's ready: use it only when you know how it starts.

issues.name_invalid: No / or \ or control characters, not starting with a dot, up to 200 bytes.
issues.name_windows: A Windows file name can't have < > : " | ? *, end in a space or dot, or be a device name like CON, NUL or COM1.
issues.multiline: One line only: the header is line by line.
issues.quoted: Values are taken literally: the quotes become part of it.
issues.ready_unknown: herdr-core knows only quiet; anything else waits for a status report.
issues.keys_unknown: hc may not know these keys (try enter, esc, ctrl+c, alt+x, f5).
issues.body_empty: No opening instructions: the agent gets only the task.
issues.codex_daemon: Codex must run with --no-daemon, or its commands run outside herdr-core.
